description: A scientist is conducting two experiments to produce electricity, experiment alpha and experiment beta. In experiment alpha, 3 units of metal and 5 units of acid are required to produce 8 units of electricity. In experiment beta, 5 units of metal and 4 units of acid are required to produced 10 units of electricity. The lab has 800 units of metal and 750 units of acid available. How many of each experiment should the scientist conduct to maximize the total amount of electricity produced?

ResourceRequired.definition: Amount of resource j required for experiment i

ElectricityProduced.definition: Amount of electricity produced by experiment i

objective.description: "The goal is to maximize the total amount of electricity produced from conducting experiment alpha and experiment beta"

constraints.description: 3 units of metal per experiment alpha times the number of alpha experiments plus 5 units of metal per experiment beta times the number of beta experiments should not exceed 800 units of metal available
5 units of acid per experiment alpha times the number of alpha experiments plus 4 units of acid per experiment beta times the number of beta experiments should not exceed 750 units of acid available
The number of experiment alpha and experiment beta conducted should be non-negative

Experiments.definition: Number of times each experiment (alpha and beta) is conducted
